data.name: Dahi
data.gender_notes: Dahi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘d-h-y’, meaning to be smooth, graceful, or pleasant. In Islamic tradition, Dahi is believed to represent the qualities of kindness, forgiveness, and gentleness. The name Dahi carries the meaning “Graceful, pleasant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dahi usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of divine grace and blessing.
data.etymology: Dahi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, pleasant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dahi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
